title: Totally Worth It
text: I was skeptical of subscribing to this but I was wrong. I love Bark Box. Better, my dog loves Bark Box. She seems to know when it comes and gets really excited. She loves getting new toys every month (and I feel less guilty throwing away the ones she’s loved to pieces). The treats are great too. I had a delivery issue (of my own making) and Bark Box went above and beyond to respond. This is a great company.
label: positive
